name: Pork Ribs
time: ~6 hr 30 min, ~30 min hands-on (mostly oven; estimated)

items: three racks of baby back ribs

steps.title: Make the rub
steps.body: Combine **¼ cup sweet paprika**, **4½ tsp freshly ground black pepper**, **4½ tsp dark brown sugar**, **1 Tbsp salt**, **1½ tsp celery salt**, **¾–1½ tsp cayenne pepper**, **1½ tsp garlic powder**, **1½ tsp dry mustard** and **1½ tsp ground cumin**.

steps.title: Rub the ribs
steps.body: Rub into **three racks of baby back ribs**.

steps.title: Bake the ribs
steps.body: To prepare in the oven, wrap ribs in heavy duty foil, sealing edges, and bake on a pan at 250°F for six hours.

steps.title: Char on the grill
steps.body: Ribs can be finished on a low temperature grill for a little charring if desired.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve with your favorite BBQ sauce.
